title: More movement: twist and forward travel

clips.label: Porcelain — travelling twist
clips.note: Wave turns upright → folds aside → cranes
clips.details:
Stronger localized turns around changing centres create a much larger composition change than the prior shot. All 28 paintings are preserved in 9⅓ seconds: three paintings per displayed second, seven RIFE frames between them. This is 1.5× faster than the fourteen-second generation timeline. The crane transition still has smearing around 5.75–5.92 seconds, and reflected left-edge patterns remain.

Krea Turbo generates the opening and every new painting. Every repaint starts from the warped previous painting, with text, three Euler sampling intervals and CFG1. Motion uses time-based Lanczos warps; RIFE 4.25 fills the gaps and never feeds back into generation. Both films deliver 24 fps.

clips.label: Malachite — through the gap
clips.note: Green passage → violet foliage → orange canyon
clips.details:
A forward zoom with alternating lateral movement and a mild elastic wave. After four seconds in this faster edit, the path steers toward the stream beside the large leaf, opening a clearer view into the canyon. All 24 paintings are preserved in eight seconds: three paintings per displayed second, seven RIFE frames between them. Some doubled translucent contours remain during the canyon conversion around 4.2–5.2 seconds. The leaf and near cliff still enlarge; this is an image-space passage, not reconstructed 3D geometry.

Krea Turbo generates the opening and every new painting. Every repaint starts from the warped previous painting, with text, three Euler sampling intervals and CFG1. Motion uses time-based Lanczos warps; RIFE 4.25 fills the gaps and never feeds back into generation. Both films deliver 24 fps.
